description: This file contains the implementation of the Setting class within the OpenCart catalog model system. It provides methods to retrieve settings and configuration values from the database, tailored for a specific store and setting code.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: A model class responsible for retrieving configuration settings from the database in the OpenCart system. It includes methods to get all settings for a store, fetch individual settings, and retrieve specific values.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all settings for a specified store, returning an array of key-value pairs, handling serialized data decoding.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Fetches all settings associated with a specific code and store id, returning an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific setting key for a given store, returning a string value.
